teaser: What happens when a number built for intuition meets four letters built for order? Life path 11 asks for a kind of knowing that arrives before the facts are in; ESTJ trusts the facts once they are in, and likes them counted twice. You are an 11 who runs meetings on time. The pull here is not between weak and strong, it is between two different ways of being certain, and both of them, in you, run hot. A hunch shows up at the worst possible hour, already dressed like an order.
